reason: issue #10: the note editor's pure arithmetic - pitch<->MIDI round-trip and the C-major spelling, the Rule 5 string/staff-tuning mirror, sounding pitch from string+fret with out-of-range strings and negative frets refused, the Rule 11 writable-pitch range (MIDI 12-131 / octaves 0-9), and duration-from-type including a divisions value that cannot express the type. Plus issue #183's dotted-duration arithmetic (durationForDots): zero dots is the plain value, one dot is 3/2 and two dots 7/4 of it, a dotted value that is not a whole number of divisions is refused, and a dot count outside 0..2 is refused. Plus issue #185's key-aware spelling: spellPitch matches the emitter's spell_pitch and preserves the sounding pitch in every key (a flat key spells a black key flat, a sharp key sharp, the octave following the spelling so B sharp 3 is MIDI 60); keyAlter is what the key signature already puts on a letter; spellWithAlter fixes the accidental and solves for the letter (a black key has no natural spelling); enharmonicSpellings are the flat/natural/sharp alternatives that sound identical; and accidentalName maps an alter to its printed accidental.
